Messages.Author: Paul Schaaf
Messages.Body:
I am a little confused as to exactly how strikes are played in combat.  
Sometimes I have a card that I want to play if the other guy does not use 
a card, or sometimes the other way around.  Is there a standard as to who 
chooses his strike first?  Many times I get an endless loop (are you 
going to use a card, I don't know are you, ...)  It seems to me that the 
attacker should decide his strike first, if a card then play it face 
down.  Then the defender should choose a strike the same way.  Then flip 
them over and see what happens.

---------
Paul Schaaf
schaaf@u.washington.edu

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Paul Schaaf  <schaaf@u.washington.edu> wrote:
>I am a little confused as to exactly how strikes are played in combat.  
>Sometimes I have a card that I want to play if the other guy does not use 
>a card, or sometimes the other way around.  Is there a standard as to who 
>chooses his strike first?...

The acting minion must choose strike first.  Once chosen, the strike cannot
be changed in reaction to the strike the blocking minion chooses.
